messages:
Emma (sec-eng): Heads-up — audit next week wants rationale for current log retention + who can request SIEM extracts. I'm proposing a short proposal: retention tiers 30d/90d/365d, SIEM export TTL 7d with CMK unwrap only for JIT analysts. Thoughts?
Olivia (infra): +1 on tiers. For exports we should avoid long-lived plaintext buckets. Idea: export to s3://sec-exports/<ticket_id>/ and set bucket encryption with CMK; use KMS-Decrypt for ephemeral role only.
Raj (oncall): How would on-call request unwraps during incident? Need a fast flow. JIT via an approval bot?
Emma (sec-eng): Exactly. Flow = ticket in PagerDuty -> create temporary role via STS assume-role with session tag -> KMS grant via our proxy for 1h -> download -> auto-delete. We already have code for ephemeral grants.
Kyle (sre): Implementation note: make sure audit logs capture the STS AssumeRole + KMS:Decrypt events. Otherwise we lose provenance. Also add an event id in the export filename for traceability.
Olivia (infra): Agree. Also add object-level metadata: {"export_ticket":"SEC-4521","requested_by":"raj","ttl":"7d"}. That way lifecycle lambda can garbage collect.
Raj (oncall): During high-severity incidents we might need 24h instead of 1h. Can the grant window be parameterized but limited to max 72h and require manager approval?
Emma (sec-eng): Yes — enforce max 72h in the grant proxy and require a 2nd approver for >8h. For audits we'll keep a CSV of every unwrap with timestamp + approver.
Olivia (infra): Quick terraform snippet for bucket lifecycle I'll drop below — use server-side CMK and object lock disabled: 
```resource \"aws_s3_bucket\" \"sec_exports\" {\n  bucket = \"sec-exports-${var.env}\"\n  server_side_encryption_configuration { ... }\n}\nresource \"aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration\" \"exports_ttl\" {\n  rule { id = \"export-7d\" prefix = \"exports/\" expiration { days = 7 } }\n}\n```
Kyle (sre): Can we avoid putting sensitive fields in logs? Suggest we scrub PII before export automatically (redact email, ip) and tag records as scrubbed.
Emma (sec-eng): Agreed — pipeline will run a redaction step. We'll keep a hashed id for correlation but no clear PII.
log-bot: ticket created SEC-4521: "SIEM export RBAC + KMS JIT flow" assigned to Olivia, Emma. (automated)
Raj (oncall): :eyes: please add a playbook note for on-call to follow when requesting unwraps.
Emma (sec-eng): I'll draft the playbook and a short checklist for auditors (who requested, who approved, duration, export hash). Planning to ship RFC by EOD.
Olivia (infra): LGTM — I'll add lifecycle + proxy changes to infra PR.
Kyle (sre): :thumbsup: Also add alert if export count spikes > 3 in 1h (possible exfil pattern).
Emma (sec-eng): Good call. Adding to monitoring tasks. Thanks team.
